Central bank raises rates

The central bank raised its benchmark interest rate by half a percentage point on Tuesday.
It was the largest move in two decades.

Policymakers said inflation remained stubbornly high and further increases were possible this year.

Short.

Markets fell after the announcement, with bank shares leading declines in afternoon trading.
